A brand identity project pays $3,000–$5,000. A monthly retainer pays $2,000–$4,000. Which one would you choose?

Our latest data from 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar shows fixed-price brand design projects ranging from $1,500 to $5,000. Stevens offers $3,000–$5,000 for a brand identity designer; Sidekicks Creative Studio pays $1,500–$3,000 for a street-food brand project. Monthly retainers for related roles: video editor $1,000–$2,000, operations lead $2,000–$4,000.

64% of listings accept worldwide remote applicants, so competition is global. But only 853 listings disclose pay—focus on those for clearer benchmarks.

Contrarian take: a $1,500–$3,000 retainer may beat a $3,000–$5,000 fixed sprint. Evaluate scope, timeline, and revisions.

Pro tip: Highlight any AI-enhanced workflow (e.g., generative mockups) – companies like EY are investing heavily in AI-driven services, and the trend is spilling over into design contracts.

157 open Design roles · 36 posted this week. Find your next high-paying gig: https://lokerdollar.com/en/remote-jobs/design
